description: This is a Java test source file for the class RetrieveAttribute, which tests various aspects such as immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and input validation for the class. It contains unit tests for the RetrieveAttribute class in the context of the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically related to thing attribute retrieval commands.
